original:
ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय ।
ॐ जयति पराशरपुत्रः सत्यवतीहृदयानन्दवर्धनः ।
यस्यास्यकमलाद्गलिता विष्णोः कीर्तिः सुधामयी ॥
transliteration:
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya |
oṃ jayati parāśaraputraḥ satyavatīhṛdayānandavardhanaḥ |
yasyāsyakamalādgalitā viṣṇoḥ kīrtiḥ sudhāmayī ||
translation: Om, salutations unto the Supreme Lord Vasudeva! Victorious is the son of Parashara, who gladdened the heart of Satyavati, from whose lotus mouth flowed the nectarine glories of Lord Vishnu.
meaning: Prathama Amsa Opening: The primordial invocation to Lord Vishnu (Vasudeva) and homage to the sage Vyasa, opening the sacred cosmological dialogue between Parashara and Maitreya.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson notes that the Vishnu Purana opens with the classic Vaishnava mangalacharana, identifying Vasudeva as the all-pervading Supreme Being whose essence sustains the cosmic creation.

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: Sridhara Swami explains that Vasudeva signifies that in which all beings abide (vasanti) and who abides in all beings, establishing non-dual devotion.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: विष्णुपुराण के प्रथम अंश का मंगलाचरण भगवान वासुदेव के सर्वव्यापक स्वरूप और महर्षि पराशर की दिव्य वाणी को नमन करता है।

original:
यस्माद्भूतं भवच्चेदं भवच्चराचरं जगत् ।
प्रलीनं यत्र तिष्ठेच्च तस्मै विष्ण्वात्मने नमः ॥
transliteration:
yasmādbhūtaṃ bhavaccedaṃ bhavaccarācaraṃ jagat |
pralīnaṃ yatra tiṣṭhecca tasmai viṣṇvātmane namaḥ ||
translation: From whom this moving and unmoving universe has emerged, in whom it abides, and into whom it shall dissolve at the cosmic dissolution—salutations unto that Supreme Self, Lord Vishnu.
meaning: Cosmological Foundation: Vishnu as the efficient and material cause (Nimitta and Upadana Karana) of the universe.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: This verse mirrors the Brahma Sutra definition of Brahman (Janmadyasya yatah). Vishnu is presented not merely as a presiding deity, but as the cosmic ground of all reality.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: जिस परम प्रभु से इस चराचर जगत की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और प्रलय होता है, उन सर्वाधार श्रीविष्णु को बारम्बार नमस्कार है।

original:
प्रणिपत्य मुनिप्रख्यं पराशरमथाब्रवीत् ।
मैत्रेयः परिपप्रच्छ संशयं हृदि संस्थितम् ॥
transliteration:
praṇipatya muniprakhyaṃ parāśaramathābravīt |
maitreyaḥ paripapraccha saṃśayaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam ||
translation: Having reverently bowed down before the illustrious sage Parashara, Maitreya humbly inquired concerning the deep philosophical doubts abiding within his heart.
meaning: The Disciple's Inception: Maitreya approaches Parashara in the classical Vedic spirit of humble inquiry (Pranipatena Pariprashnena).

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Maitreya, an earnest student of philosophy, represents the sincere human intellect seeking to comprehend the cosmic laws of creation and liberation.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: मैत्रेय जी ने परम ज्ञानी महर्षि पराशर के चरणों में प्रणाम कर संसार के रहस्य और ईश्वर के यथार्थ स्वरूप के विषय में प्रश्न किया।

original:
कथं सृष्टमिदं विश्वं कथं चैतद्विनश्यति ।
केन वा ध्रियते सर्वं कश्चास्य जगतः प्रभुः ॥
transliteration:
kathaṃ sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ kathaṃ caitadvinaśyati |
kena vā dhriyate sarvaṃ kaścāsya jagataḥ prabhuḥ ||
translation: How was this universe brought forth into existence? How does it dissolve? By whom is it sustained? And who is the supreme sovereign lord of this vast cosmic manifestation?
meaning: The Four Cosmic Inquiries: Origin, dissolution, sustenance, and the supreme ruler of existence.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: These four foundational questions form the structural framework for the entirety of the Vishnu Purana's six sections.

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: मैत्रेयांचे हे प्रश्न विश्वाची निर्मिती, स्थिती आणि प्रलयाच्या मुळाशी असलेले अंतिम ईश्वरी सत्य शोधण्यासाठी आहेत.

original:
पराशर उवाच —
शृणु मैत्रेय यत्पृष्टं त्वया लोकहितैषिणा ।
यद्वसिष्ठेन मे प्रोक्तं पुलस्त्येन च धीमता ॥
transliteration:
parāśara uvāca —
śṛṇu maitreya yatpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā lokahitaiṣiṇā |
yadvasiṣṭhena me proktaṃ pulastyena ca dhīmatā ||
translation: Parashara replied: Listen, O Maitreya, to that which you have asked for the welfare of the world, even as it was imparted to me formerly by the venerable Vashistha and the wise Pulastya.
meaning: Sacred Lineage (Parampara): Wisdom transmitted through the ancient seers Vashistha and Pulastya.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Parashara traces his knowledge to a divine boon granted by Pulastya, the son of Brahma, in consequence of Parashara having restrained his anger against the Rakshasas.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: महर्षि पराशर ने बताया कि यह ज्ञान उन्हें महर्षि वशिष्ठ और महर्षि पुलस्त्य के आशीर्वाद और उपदेश से प्राप्त हुआ था।

original:
प्रकृतिर्या मयाख्याता व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरुपिणी ।
पुरुषश्चाप्युभावेतौ लीयेते परमात्मनि ॥
transliteration:
prakṛtiryā mayākhyātā vyaktāvyaktasvarupiṇī |
puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani ||
translation: Nature (Prakriti), which I have declared unto you as manifest and unmanifest, and the individual soul (Purusha)—both of these ultimately merge and dissolve into the Supreme Self, Lord Vishnu.
meaning: Synthesis of Samkhya and Vedanta: Matter and spirit are recognized as twin energies of the one supreme reality.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Here the Purana elevates the dualism of classical Samkhya into the non-dual monotheism of Vedanta, where both Prakriti and Purusha are subordinate modes of Vishnu.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: प्रकृति और पुरुष दोनों ही परब्रह्म परमात्मा श्रीविष्णु की शक्तियां हैं और महाप्रलय में उन्हीं में लीन हो जाती हैं।

original:
ध्रुवस्य चरितं पुण्यं शृण्वतां पापनाशनम् ।
भगवत्यचला भक्तिर्यतो भवति शाश्वती ॥
transliteration:
dhruvasya caritaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam |
bhagavatyacalā bhaktiryato bhavati śāśvatī ||
translation: The auspicious and sacred narrative of child Dhruva destroys all sins in those who hear it, awakening unwavering, eternal devotion unto the Supreme Lord.
meaning: The Story of Dhruva: The boy-prince who attained the eternal North Star through resolute penance and unshakeable faith.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: The Dhruva narrative in Book 1 serves as the archetypal demonstration that child-like purity combined with intense meditation compels divine grace.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: बालक ध्रुव की निष्काम तपस्या और भगवान नारायण की प्राप्ति की कथा संसार के समस्त साधकों को दृढ़ संकल्प का संदेश देती है।

original:
प्रह्लाद उवाच —
यथा प्रह्लादसंस्मृत्या विष्णौ भक्तिः स्थिरा भवेत् ।
तथैव सर्वभूतेषु मैत्री भवतु मे सदा ॥
transliteration:
prahlāda uvāca —
yathā prahlādasaṃsmṛtyā viṣṇau bhaktiḥ sthirā bhavet |
tathaiva sarvabhūteṣu maitrī bhavatu me sadā ||
translation: Prahlada declared: Even as by contemplating Lord Vishnu one's devotion becomes unshakable, so may universal friendliness and goodwill abide in my heart toward all living beings forever.
meaning: Prahlada's Universal Compassion: True devotion to Vishnu blossoms into boundless love and kindness toward every creature.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Wilson remarks that Prahlada's character in the Vishnu Purana is portrayed with profound ethical nobility, praying even for the deliverance of his demonic persecutors.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: भक्त प्रह्लाद की भक्ति का मूल आधार सभी प्राणियों में भगवान का दर्शन करना और सबके प्रति मैत्री भाव रखना है।

original:
सर्वभूतेषु येन त्वं समबुद्धिः प्रजायसे ।
तस्मात्प्रसन्नो भगवान् मुक्तिं दास्यत्यसंशयम् ॥
transliteration:
sarvabhūteṣu yena tvaṃ samabuddhiḥ prajāyase |
tasmātprasanno bhagavān muktiṃ dāsyatyasaṃśayam ||
translation: Because you look upon all living beings with an equal, serene vision, therefore the Supreme Lord is well-pleased with you and will grant you supreme liberation without doubt.
meaning: Equanimity (Samabuddhi) as the Highest Yoga: Lord Vishnu's benediction upon those who perceive divinity in all creatures.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Samabuddhi represents the highest spiritual realization, where the distinction between friend and foe dissolves in universal divine awareness.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: सभी जीवों में समभाव रखने वाले भक्त को भगवान विष्णु सहज ही परम पद (मोक्ष) प्रदान करते हैं।

original:
तस्मादविद्यासंभूतं त्यक्त्वा भेदं महामुने ।
आत्मनात्मानमीक्षस्व सर्वभूतेषु संस्थितम् ॥
transliteration:
tasmādavidyāsaṃbhūtaṃ tyaktvā bhedaṃ mahāmune |
ātmanātmānamīkṣasva sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitam ||
translation: Therefore, O great sage, casting aside all false sense of division born of spiritual ignorance, behold the one Supreme Self residing equally within all beings.
meaning: The Supreme Culmination of Prathama Amsa: The transcendence of duality and realization of cosmic oneness in Vishnu.

layers.author: hh-wilson
layers.content: Book 1 concludes with this sublime Vedantic admonition to abandon the illusion of separateness and behold the universal Atman in all existence.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: अज्ञान से उत्पन्न भेदभाव का त्याग करके सभी प्राणियों में एक ही अविनाशी आत्म-तत्व का दर्शन करना ही विष्णुपुराण का परम उपदेश है।
